meta.title: dkitchen
meta.description: Run a kitchen of DeepSeek Harness sessions: create stations, hand out tickets, launch long jobs, and read what came back.

setupNote: The bundle only mounts dkitchen's tools. The Python package provides them, so these commands are still yours to run:
setupAsk: Ask the agent in any session to install dkitchen, and it runs these for you.
agentMessage: The dsh-dkitchen bundle is installed, but dkitchen's tools are missing until its Python package is present. If the user wants them, run these two commands with your shell tool, in order: `python -m pip install dkitchen` (pipx install dkitchen if that is how this machine manages standalone tools), then `ding plugin install`, which writes the kitchen profile, adds the route bundles, and installs this bundle into the profile the user opens conversations in. Then tell the user to restart DeepSeek Harness. Do not run them unasked: installing software is the user's decision.
